services.name: Escape room
services.desc: Escape the Museum: “The Curse of the Curate’s Collection Based on a real local history mystery. You and your team are museum interns called to assist historian A.R. Chive in locating the missing Rev. Mitchell Collection and announcing its discovery before your rivals do. Oh, and times-a-ticking…you only have 60 minutes on the clock, so every moment is crucial to your escape! What is an Escape Room? An escape room is an immersive adventure where participants, often teams of six people, are placed in a room and use teamwork, along with elements of the room, to find hidden clues and solve puzzles to complete a mission or “escape” within a set time limit.
